questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a physical clock in a computer?
options: To keep track of the date
To measure the passage of time
To synchronize with other computers
To generate random numbers
questions.answer: To measure the passage of time

questions.question: What is clock skew?
options: The time it takes for a clock to start
The difference in time between two clocks
The speed at which a clock runs
The time it takes to synchronize a clock
questions.answer: The difference in time between two clocks

questions.question: Why is clock synchronization important in distributed systems?
options: To ensure all computers have the same hardware
To coordinate actions between processes
To reduce network latency
To improve the performance of individual computers

questions.question: In Cristian's algorithm, how does the client estimate the one-way network delay?
options: It asks the server for the delay
It assumes the delay is zero
It measures the round-trip time and divides by two
It uses a constant value for the delay
questions.answer: It measures the round-trip time and divides by two

questions.question: What is a potential problem with Cristian's algorithm if the network delay is highly variable?
options: The client's clock will run faster
The client's clock will run slower
The synchronization will be inaccurate
The server will crash

questions.question: What is the role of a time server in clock synchronization?
options: To provide a reference time
To slow down the clocks of clients
To speed up the clocks of clients
To stop the clocks of clients

questions.question: How does NTP improve upon Cristian's algorithm?
options: It uses a single time server
It ignores network delay
It uses a hierarchical system of time servers and statistical filtering
It only works on local networks
questions.answer: It uses a hierarchical system of time servers and statistical filtering

questions.question: What is a stratum 1 NTP server?
options: A server that is not synchronized
A server that is synchronized with a client
A server that is synchronized with an atomic clock or GPS
A server that is synchronized with another stratum 1 server
questions.answer: A server that is synchronized with an atomic clock or GPS

questions.question: If a client's clock is ahead of the server's clock, what should the client do after receiving the server's time?
options: Set its clock forward
Set its clock backward
Do nothing
Ask the server to change its clock
